concept.hr: Firmware → pokretač sustava → jezgra → initramfs → systemd: lanac predaja
concept.en: Firmware → boot loader → kernel → initramfs → systemd: a chain of hand-overs

summary.hr: Korak po korak od uključenja do prijave: svaka karika predaje upravljanje sljedećoj. Pokvari jednu i lanac stane baš ondje.
summary.en: Step from power on to the login: each link hands control to the next. Break one, and the chain stops right there.

concept.hr: Jezgra radi, pravi korijen se ne pronalazi: hitna ljuska u initramfs-u
concept.en: The kernel runs, the real root never shows up: emergency shell in the initramfs

concept.hr: PID 1 radi, ali redak u /etc/fstab ne uspije: emergency.target
concept.en: PID 1 runs, but a line in /etc/fstab fails: emergency.target

concept.hr: UEFI → Boot Manager → winload → jezgra → smss → winlogon
concept.en: UEFI → Boot Manager → winload → kernel → smss → winlogon

concept.hr: Boot Manager ne zna koji winload.efi pokrenuti: zaslon za oporavak
concept.en: Boot Manager does not know which winload.efi to start: the recovery screen
